parameters.query: SELECT c.id as client_id, c.client_code, c.company_name, c.plan_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE client_id = c.id) as total_contacts, c.max_contacts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE client_id = c.id AND lead_status = 'customer') as customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE client_id = c.id AND lead_score >= 80) as hot_leads, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals d JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = d.contact_id WHERE ct.client_id = c.id AND d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) as pipeline_value, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals d JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = d.contact_id WHERE ct.client_id = c.id AND d.stage = 'closed_won' AND d.updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW())) as revenue_mtd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracked_keywords WHERE client_id = c.id AND is_active = true) as tracked_keywords, c.max_keywords, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM keyword_rankings kr JOIN tracked_keywords tk ON tk.id = kr.keyword_id WHERE tk.client_id = c.id AND kr.position <= 10 AND kr.checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day') as top10_count FROM clients c WHERE c.api_key = '{{ $json.api_key }}' AND c.status = 'active' LIMIT 1

SELECT c2.id, c2.email, c2.first_name, c2.last_name, c2.company, c2.lead_score, c2.lead_status, c2.source, c2.created_at FROM contacts c2 JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = c2.client_id WHERE cl.api_key = '{{ $json.api_key }}' AND cl.status = 'active' {{ $json.status ? "AND c2.lead_status = '" + $json.status + "'" : '' }} {{ $json.search ? "AND (c2.email ILIKE '%" + $json.search + "%' OR c2.first_name ILIKE '%" + $json.search + "%' OR c2.company ILIKE '%" + $json.search + "%')" : '' }} ORDER BY c2.created_at DESC LIMIT {{ $json.limit }} OFFSET {{ ($json.page - 1) * $json.limit }}

SELECT tk.id, tk.keyword, tk.target_url, kr.position, kr.previous_position, (kr.previous_position - kr.position) as change, kr.search_volume, kr.checked_at FROM tracked_keywords tk LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM keyword_rankings WHERE keyword_id = tk.id ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1) kr ON true JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = tk.client_id WHERE cl.api_key = '{{ $json.api_key }}' AND cl.status = 'active' AND tk.is_active = true ORDER BY kr.search_volume DESC NULLS LAST
